collection.title: Peugeot 307 CC 2003 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Peugeot 307 CC 2003 to 2005 Onwards model which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 24" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
